newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end down, bargain-hunting seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end down, bargain-hunting seen.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended lower for the fifth straight session on Friday, but dealers said bargain-hunting interest lifted the market off its lows.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished 40 points above its intra-day low of 20,720 against a previous settlement at 21,060. Turnover was a moderate 19,745 lots.
"It tried to come back up but the momentum is still headed down," said a trader with a local institution.
Dealers said the market remained on weakened ground after making a poor start following a weak close in Chicago and four days of losses on Wall Street.
Uncertainty over the direction of Japanese government policy and the formation of a new coalition after last Sunday's election also continued to depress interest.
"If it gets above 20,950, it could stabilise. And a close above 21,125 could bring some upside," said the trader.
He said the December Nikkei would find initial support around 20,680-750.
